parts.text:
A wide cinematic matte-painting style background illustration with a soft clay-render finish.
An aurora night sky above a quiet forest silhouette: a slow luminous aurora band sweeping from teal (#4FE3C1) to lime (#B6FF5C), a violet-navy nebula haze, tiny star specks and a few warm fireflies low over the treeline.
Deep navy space sky (#0B1030 to #151C48) filling the frame, dark pine and broadleaf silhouettes along the bottom edge, the right third of the frame kept calm, dark and free of bright shapes so an information panel can sit there.
Ultra-wide 16:9, low horizon, soft gradients, gentle volumetric glow, no hard edges in the sky, restrained contrast for a projector, sharp foliage silhouettes.
Style anchor: Glossy 3D clay sticker style in the Arise Soul sticker language: chibi bell / gumdrop bodies with two soft foot nubs, an antenna stalk topped by a glowing orb, big soft top highlight, warm peach rim light, bubble speckles in two sizes (mint #7CF5C8, cyan #63E6FF, lilac #8B7CF0), a thick white die-cut sticker outline with a soft drop shadow.
Sky: Deep navy space background (#0B1030 to #151C48) with a slow aurora band drifting from teal #4FE3C1 to lime #B6FF5C and tiny star specks.
No characters, no creatures, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no lens flare across the right third.
No human face or human likeness of any kind. No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, logos or watermarks. No level, rank, tier, score, XP or badge labels. All figures are the same size and brightness; nothing looks stronger or more important than anything else.
